call_points.text: CG secured a ₹900 Cr power transformers export order from Tallgrass Integrated Logistics Solutions LLC USA.
CG Semi's G1 facility is on track to commence commercial production in calendar year 2026.
FY27 core capex guided at ₹300-350 Cr, plus a rough ₹300 Cr into subsidiaries including TICMPL and TI Medical.
Naidupet CDMO plant is under final commissioning; commercial production starts next quarter.
Engineering Q4 volume growth was in line with sales growth as there were no major price movements.
Commodity increases are recovered from customers under contracts, with a one or two quarter lag; fuel inflation is the immediate challenge.
EV truck order book is good; deployment of 50-100 trucks needs about ₹100 Cr plus per customer and charging setup, targeted for Q1 and Q2.
Three-wheeler Q4 output was about half of potential due to a body-in-white supplier; the facility has been taken over and ramp-up is targeted by end of Q1.
Railway/Vande Bharat business awaits customer product approval with the Government of India; progress expected in two to three quarters.
MFP is slow on railways tender profitability and a muted Hyundai; the Pune door-frame facility is ramping with Hyundai's western plant.
TI Medical guided to 15-20% growth in wound care and 20% YoY overall; the Medicura IV cannula asset purchase is closed.
Montra Electric Rhino was the first electric truck certified under the PM E-drive scheme, in Q4.
Board recommended a final dividend of ₹1.50 per share for FY26 after a ₹2 interim paid in February 2026.

operating_notes.text: TII agreed to invest ₹75 Cr and Mr. N Govindarajan ₹25 Cr in 3xper Innoventure Limited via CCPS at ₹100 each.
Q4FY26 segment results: Power Systems ₹352.01 Cr, Industrial Systems ₹153.12 Cr, Engineering ₹175.95 Cr; Electric Vehicles segment loss ₹199.14 Cr including fair value loss on CCPS liability.
CG Power and Industrial Solutions (56% held) Q4FY26 consolidated revenue ₹3,442 Cr against ₹2,753 Cr; Shanthi Gears (70% held) revenue ₹135 Cr against ₹153 Cr.
Q4FY26 EV volumes: 87 big trucks, 241 small commercial vehicles, 1,176 three-wheelers, no tractor billing.
EV market share about 28% in trucks and 27% in small commercial vehicles in Q4FY26.
CRSS plant at Nashik ramping, expected 100% utilised by end-FY27 or mid-FY28; western tube facilities at about 30% utilisation.
Engineering volumes grew about 17% in Q1FY27 with exports up double digits and about 14% of TI revenue.
E-mobility billing volumes in Q1FY27: 86 big trucks, 1,924 three-wheelers, 347 small commercial vehicles and 22 tractors.
The 200 KL CDMO intermediate capacity is commissioned with validation batches running; clean room due in 30-40 days and site inspection expected next financial year.
